world_read.summary: A pale, heavily textured ground supports a large skull-like violet-gray assemblage at left, a separate curled violet fragment at upper right, and a rust-red and gold shelf at lower right. Paired black hollows, sharp ivory blades, teal insets, a small branching colored ridge, and a scraped multicolored pocket provide distinct visible interaction anchors. Thin raised ivory threads cross the open ground. The plate is expressionist and spatially restrained, though its main forms contain dense surface detail. Not every planned spatial relationship is present: the conspicuous ivory ledge belongs to the left assemblage, and the rust shelf sits beneath the right fragment rather than beneath the larger left cluster.
mood: On warm ivory, two unequal fractured pigment clusters flank a channel. The larger bears a violet dome, paired dark hollows and ivory blades; the smaller, a violet-blue fold. Turquoise inserts, purple ovals, ocher scratches and bridging white cords join a minor rust shelf, bright branching ridge, chunky ledge and speckled scrape.
